name: Zajac
source: Based on the moments at which he manifests himself, albeit in the form of Anton's thoughts, we can conclude that the Bunny is an embittered, but rather cowardly creature. If Anton is in danger, the Bunny advises him to run for his life, no matter what. In addition, if Anton, in the second episode, under pressure from Semyon and his friends, decides to put a rabbit mask on his face, the Bunny will convince him that after that, "no one will harm him." Because of his aggression and cowardice, Bunny does not seem to share Anton's desire to fight back against his abusers, instead wanting to hurt or wish death to his classmates and the missing children, believing that the latter deserved what happened to them. Even the kind and polite Polina, after Anton's string of failures, seems to the Bunny to be a bad person to the point that he calls her a "Slut."
